contributions.anchor: Form A's own printed 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report)' = 5,000.00, which equals the cover's 'Totals for This Report' line-1 cell (5,000.00)
contributions.detail: The single Form A row (Utah Forward PAC, 5,000.00) sums to 5,000.00 = the schedule's printed total = the cover's This-Report cell. The cover's CUMULATIVE line-1 cell is 13,895.18 because 8,895.18 was carried in the 'Totals from Last Report' column from Froerer's earlier 2022 report; the 13,895.18 - 5,000.00 = 8,895.18 residual is prior-period money this schedule does not itemize. 2022 form is the 3-line variant, so there is no separate <=$50 aggregate cell and contrib_all is the anchor.

expenditures.anchor: Form B's own printed 'Total Expenditures: (to line 2 of report)' = 9,624.58, which equals BOTH the cover's This-Report and its Cumulative line-2 cells (9,624.58)
expenditures.detail: 6 Form B rows: 1,000.00 + 500.00 + 1,215.00 + 3,254.58 + 66.00 + 3,589.00 = 9,624.58, to the cent. The cover's line-2 'Totals from Last Report' cell is a bare dash (the filer restarted the expenditure count at this report), so this-report and cumulative are the same figure and the side is exact rather than period-exact.

itemized.escalation_note: 900 dpi --value crops on p38 (row-1 date cell and row-1 amount cell) to prove the extrapolated row grid on a rotated sheet whose vertical rules the default detector under-reports; 500-700 dpi --value crops on p39 for the amount-column band and for the p39 row-4 / row-6 name cells ('Weber County Jr. Livestock Donation' and the one-word vendor 'Arena', both confirmed verbatim). No amount was in doubt; every escalation was legibility/geometry, and the printed schedule totals gated both sides.
